- [E45, E50] Another complete cycle (magnitude ~6.8 drop from indices 52-57, then magnitude ~7.3 rise from indices 57-62)
- [E54, E59] Final observed cycle (magnitude ~8.0 drop from indices 62-67, then magnitude ~8.2 rise from indices 67-72)

## Local Minima
- [E8] Local trough at index 8 (value: 95.77)
- [E49, E58] Local trough at index 57 (value: 96.09), representing a moderate-strength minimum
